text: Bytecode inspection of cached sbt-ci-release 1.11.2 confirms ci-release returns before GPG setup and publish commands when secure CI variables are absent. A local credential-scrubbed ci-release dry run was not executed because the managed sandbox rejected entry into a publication-capable task without explicit user authorization. This is policy evidence, not a product failure. Owner action remains: install/confirm the four repository secrets and explicitly authorize the nonpublishing wiring test; no secret values were read, printed, or stored.
